pull.title: KAFKA-16191: Clean up of consumer client internal events
pull.body:
There are a few minor issues with the event sub-classes in the
`org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.internals.events` package that should be cleaned up:

- Update the names of subclasses to remove the superfluous `Application` or `Background` term
- Make `equals()`, `hashCode()`, and `toString()` `final` in the base classes and clean up the implementations of `toStringBase()`
- Fix minor whitespace inconsistencies
- Make variable/method names consistent

### Committer Checklist (excluded from commit message)
- [ ] Verify design and implementation 
- [ ] Verify test coverage and CI build status
- [ ] Verify documentation (including upgrade notes)
